title: melt down into ...U
writeup:
[heading]i think this is my best map[/heading]

heavily inspired by [url=https://osu.ppy.sh/users/5219516]ameth[/url], but not a 1:1 copy since i still don't fully understand how to emulate the best of his patterning

really really like the first half, wish the final kiai drop was a bit cooler but otherwise this is my best high level execution by a mile, very proud of it
